title: Approvals delegation: the form lets an admin pick any delegator, the server refuses with 403, and the UI says nothing
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-14** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, `/sys_approval_delegation` → New; delegator Priya Raman, delegate Tomas Okafor.
- **Expected:** the empty state "Declare an out-of-office delegation so approvals route to a backup while you are away" plus a Delegator field listing every user.
- **Actual:** `POST /api/v1/data/sys_approval_delegation` → 403 "you may only manage out-of-office delegations where you are the delegator"; no toast, no field error, the dialog just stays. With the admin as delegator it saves (201).
- **Evidence:** [`21-F-delegations-create-403.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/21-F-delegations-create-403.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** admins covering an absent employee.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `plugin-approvals` (delegation write rule) and console form (silent 403).
- **Dedupe words:** delegation 403 delegator, OOO delegation admin, silent forbidden.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** the delegation form's delegator field (`plugin-approvals` metadata) offers people the server will refuse. The console's silent swallow of the 403 is objectui's half; triage may split it.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 1 + 6 hits in objectstack, 0 in objectui, none on point. **New.**
